Discovery call — Summit Outdoor Outfitters (retail, outdoor gear chain)

Called in with Dana from the DC office. They're a regional outdoor retailer
opening three new stores this year and want one CTV campaign running across
all three trade areas, not three separate proposals.

The markets are Denver, Atlanta and Phoenix. Denver is the flagship — it's
where the brand started and where they already have the most awareness.
Atlanta and Phoenix are the new builds. They asked specifically whether we
could show them what the streaming audience looks like in each of the three,
because their board wants to see the markets side by side before signing off.

Budget is $90,000 total for the flight, split evenly across the three
markets. Flight is October through December.

Audience is adults 25-54 who are outdoor recreation enthusiasts, skew toward
higher household income, homeowners.

Premion Streaming TV for the main buy. They also want retargeting on the
back of it — site visitors who didn't purchase. No live sports, they were
clear about that, the board thinks it's off-brand.

Agency is involved — Meridian handles their media.

Open question: they mentioned maybe adding a fourth market next year but
nothing confirmed, so leave it out of this proposal.
